title: feat(electron): i18n for renderer UI driven by language setting
body:
Add message bundles and runtime (setUiLocale, t, subscribeLocale). Wire toolbar, status line, settings panel, vault/outline/search/backlinks, and live-preview image chrome to locale changes from settings.

feat(electron): i18n for renderer UI driven by language setting

Add message bundles and runtime (setUiLocale, t, subscribeLocale). Wire toolbar, status line, settings panel, vault/outline/search/backlinks, and live-preview image chrome to locale changes from settings.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

+function mergeMessages(partial: Partial<Record<MessageId, string>>): Record<MessageId, string> {
+  const out = { ...en } as Record<MessageId, string>;
+  for (const k of Object.keys(partial) as MessageId[]) {
+    const v = partial[k];
+    if (v !== undefined) out[k] = v;
+  }
+  return out;
+}

+/** Pick a message table from a BCP 47 tag (from settings / navigator). */
+export function resolveMessages(tag: string): Record<MessageId, string> {
+  const raw = tag.toLowerCase().trim();
